limits: These are evaluator tests using synthetic records, not actual compiler or performance qualification.
File hashes do not prove independent capture, truthful durations, plan chronology, semantic equivalence or completeness of declared execution dependencies.
Version1 binds direct compiler entry execution only; arbitrary Cargo and wrapper invocation chains remain outside its supported capture contract.
Full Rust coverage, exclusive ownership, selective import closure and package qualification remain independently unproven.
meaningful_controls: Favorable geometric mean with a slower weighted elapsed total is rejected.
Both near-stock numeric budgets can pass while overall total is slower; no overall pass follows.
An actual synthetic total speedup with a near-Lust miss stays distinct and never grants release admission.
Complete pair blocks, declared frequencies, confidence interval and empirical tails are retained.
Changed plans, requests, argv, identities, helper binaries, outputs, status, signal, durations and missing observations are refused.
A matching plan and receipt for an unrelated executable cannot substitute for the declared direct compiler entry.
Numeric per-case targets apply only to the documented operation/lifecycle scopes.
Expected rejection remains measured separately and cannot receive the successful supported warm near-stock target.
scope: Current performance evaluator arithmetic and evidence-integrity controls only
